visualCharacteristics.description: White band with horizontal carousel of product cards (optional ISOCLEAN Certified badge, product image, product name link, text link + outlined button, 3 bullet benefits) with prev/next arrows and dots.

contentPattern.description: One row per product card. Cell 1: optional badge image followed by the product image. Cell 2: title (heading or bold) linked to the product page, a text link, a button link (last link renders as outlined button), and a bullet list of benefits.
contentPattern.structure: N rows (6 on source) x 2 cells: image cell + text cell

suitableFor: product cards with image, title, links and benefit bullets
